actions.name: Pressure Strike
actions.description: Before you make a melee attack roll, you can choose to make a Pressure Strike, increasing its damage by 1d4 and giving the attack Brutal 1. Reroll any 1s on the weapon and Pressure Strike damage dice until they show another result. The additional damage die is not multiplied on a critical hit.

actions.name: Demolition
actions.description: As a full-round action, make one attack against an object or one sunder maneuver, dealing an additional 2d6 damage and ignoring 5 points of its hardness. The additional damage dice are not multiplied on a critical hit.

actions.name: Telescoping Thrust
actions.description: Before you make a melee attack roll, you can extend the spear, increasing your reach by 5 feet for that attack. This does not increase the area you threaten or allow you to attack adjacent targets.

actions.name: Impaling Drive
actions.description: As a standard action, make a melee attack against each of up to two targets directly in line within your reach, increased by 5 feet. Roll separately for each target using your highest attack bonus. The first target takes normal damage and the second takes half damage. You can attack the second target even if you miss the first. This does not increase the area you threaten or allow you to attack adjacent targets.

actions.name: Driving Blow
actions.description: Before you make a melee attack roll, you can choose to make a Driving Blow. On a damaging hit, you can push the target up to 5 feet directly away from you. The target must be no more than one size category larger than you. This movement stops at obstructions, deals no collision damage and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

actions.name: Pile-driver
actions.description: As a standard action, make one melee attack. On a damaging hit, you can attempt a trip maneuver against the target with a +2 bonus. This trip attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and a failed attempt cannot trip you. The target must be a creature you can normally trip.

actions.name: Guided Cut
actions.description: Before you make a melee attack roll, you can engage Guided Cut to gain a +2 bonus on that attack roll and any critical confirmation roll for that attack.

actions.name: Guard Breaker
actions.description: As a standard action, make a melee attack with the included accuracy bonus from Guided Cut. On a damaging hit, the target is flat-footed until the end of your next turn.

actions.name: Vibrating Edge
actions.description: Before you make a melee attack roll, you can engage Vibrating Edge, increasing the weapon’s critical threat range by 1 for that attack. Apply this increase after Keen or Improved Critical; those two effects do not stack with each other. Critical threats still require confirmation.

actions.name: Critical Overdrive
actions.description: Before you make a melee attack roll, you can engage Critical Overdrive, gaining the threat-range increase from Vibrating Edge and increasing the weapon’s critical multiplier by 1 for that attack. Sneak attack and other additional damage dice are not multiplied on a critical hit.

actions.name: Powered Grip
actions.description: For 1 minute, gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Strength checks to lift, bend, force open or hold objects and on combat manoeuvre checks to grapple.

actions.name: Precision Rig
actions.description: Gain a +2 circumstance bonus on one Craft check. When rushing the construction or repair of technological equipment, gain +5 instead. These bonuses do not stack. An armour specialist gains +4 or +10, respectively. The rig covers one crafting check regardless of the work period it represents. Rushing raises the Craft DC by 5.

actions.name: Assisted Stride
actions.description: Before taking a move action to move, increase your land speed by 10 feet for that move. This does not grant an extra action or prevent attacks of opportunity.

actions.name: Vault
actions.description: As a move action, jump up to 10 feet horizontally or 5 feet vertically without an Acrobatics check. You must have a clear path. This jump does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Vault can also be used as part of a charge and counts as the movement required to initiate that charge.

actions.name: Brace
actions.description: Before an opponent rolls a trip, bull rush, reposition, disarm or sunder manoeuvre against you or equipment you wear or wield, gain +2 CMD against that manoeuvre.

actions.name: Interpose
actions.description: When an adjacent ally is hit by a weapon or natural attack, intercept up to 5 damage. Declare before damage is rolled. The armour takes the intercepted damage, reduced by its hardness minus 10 (minimum 0). Broken armour cannot Interpose.

actions.name: Deflect
actions.description: Before an attack roll against you, increase your shield bonus to AC by 1 against that attack.

actions.name: Deploy Bulwark
actions.description: Plant and unfold the shield across 1 connected 5-foot edges. It provides partial cover against attacks passing through those edges. It remains deployed until disengaged or destroyed without further fuel expenditure. Disengage and reclaim it as a move action, or leave it behind. While deployed it provides cover rather than an equipped shield bonus. Anyone can shelter behind it.

actions.name: Deflect
actions.description: Before an attack roll against you, increase your shield bonus to AC by 2 against that attack.

actions.name: Deploy Bulwark
actions.description: Plant and unfold the shield across 2 connected 5-foot edges. It provides partial cover against attacks passing through those edges. It remains deployed until disengaged or destroyed without further fuel expenditure. Disengage and reclaim it as a move action, or leave it behind. While deployed it provides cover rather than an equipped shield bonus. Anyone can shelter behind it.

ironwright.notes: Weapon family or armour specialisation begins at 1st level. Powered Attack Training increases at 7th, 12th and 17th levels. Maintenance restores reservoir per item attuned throughout the rest. Technical knack options and detailed technology crafting and repair procedures remain pending.

fieldRepairs.description: At 4th level, repair technological equipment using suitable scrap instead of purchased materials. Checks, repair amounts and times await the technology crafting rules.

overload.description: As a swift action, overload one equipped technological item. Its powered abilities cost no reservoir and retain normal action requirements. After the first powered ability each round, take 20% of maximum item HP as damage, rounded up, bypassing hardness. End as a free action on your turn; it ends automatically when broken, destroyed or unequipped. On ending, the powered mechanism breaks and requires workshop repair; restoring HP and Field Repairs do not fix it. At level 20, strain becomes 10% and the item gains +2 weapon damage or +2 to its armour or shield AC bonus.

notes: Defensive models use four reservoir plus two per enhancement. Prices are 150% of the recorded comparison item. The unarmoured harness uses leather as its price comparison; the articulated medium suit uses a chain shirt.
Armour specialisation doubles armour and shield powered benefits. Tech Armour Training applies to all Ironwrights.

Interpose uses normal item HP and hardness minus 10. Workshop harness durability is a campaign minimum of 5 HP. Material choices change hardness only; other special-material rules and prices are resolved at the table.

rules.name: Challenge
manual: Swift action; lasts until the challenged target is dead or unconscious or combat ends. Turn the toggle off yourself when it ends. While active, Normal AC includes the −2 penalty against other attackers. Other cavalier features remain manual.

rules.name: Sword order challenge bonus
manual: Uncheck order benefit availability during an edict suspension. Only the Sword challenge bonus is implemented; other order abilities remain manual.

rules.name: Outflank

effects.description: A critical hit against this flanked creature provokes an attack of opportunity from your ally. Resolve it at the table.

manual: The conditional line includes the normal +2 flanking bonus plus the +2 Outflank increase, for +4 total. Your ally must also have Outflank. Solo Tactics and Tactician sharing remain manual.

rules.name: Smite Evil

variants.label: Smite: first hit vs evil outsider, evil dragon or undead

effects.description: Smite attacks bypass the smitten target’s damage reduction.

manual: Bonuses apply only against your chosen smitten evil target, not every evil creature. Smiting a non-evil target wastes the use with no effect.

The first-successful-hit damage bonus is doubled against an outsider with the evil subtype, an evil-aligned dragon, or undead. Use that line only for the qualifying first hit; later hits use the regular smite line.

Swift action; lasts until the target dies or you rest and regain uses. AC in a smite row is against that target. Other paladin features, including Divine Grace and the level-20 capstone, remain manual.

rules.name: Dodge (Combat)
manual: Dodge bonuses are lost when denied Dexterity to AC.

rules.name: Mobility (Combat)
manual: Only applies to attacks of opportunity caused by moving out of or within a threatened area, not every attack of opportunity. Lost when denied Dexterity to AC.

rules.name: Precise Shot (Combat)
manual: Cancels the normal −4 firing-into-melee penalty only. It does not remove cover or concealment penalties.

rules.name: Power Attack (Combat)
manual: Choose the selected weapon’s damage handling: standard, two-handed/1½ Strength primary natural attack, or off-hand/secondary natural attack. The mode also adjusts the positive Strength damage modifier. These modifiers do not supply extra attacks, off-hand attack penalties or proficiency rules.
The attack and maneuver penalties remain while toggled on. Bonus damage does not apply to touch attacks or effects that do not deal hit point damage. Turn off when its duration ends.

rules.name: Deadly Aim (Combat)
manual: Bonus damage does not apply to touch attacks or effects that do not deal hit point damage; the ranged attack penalty still applies. No attacks or duration are tracked.

rules.name: Improved Trip (Combat)

effects.description: Your trip maneuver does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

manual: Checks use the selected melee weapon where applicable. Weapon eligibility, reach, size restrictions and maneuver outcomes are adjudicated at the table.

effects.description:
In melee, every time you miss because of concealment (see Combat), you can reroll your miss chance percentile roll one time to see if you actually hit.
An invisible attacker gets no advantages related to hitting you in melee. That is, you don't lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class, and the attacker doesn't get the usual +2 bonus for being invisible. The invisible attacker's bonuses do still apply for ranged attacks, however.
You do not need to make Acrobatics skill checks to move at full speed while blinded.

You gain a +4 bonus on the following checks and saves: Swim checks made to resist nonlethal damage from exhaustion; Constitution checks made to continue running; Constitution checks made to avoid nonlethal damage from a forced march; Constitution checks made to hold your breath; Constitution checks made to avoid nonlethal damage from starvation or thirst; Fortitude saves made to avoid nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments; and Fortitude saves made to resist damage from suffocation.

rules.name: Diehard

effects.description:
When your hit point total is below 0, but you are not dead, you automatically stabilize. You do not need to make a Constitution check each round to avoid losing additional hit points. You may choose to act as if you were disabled, rather than dying. You must make this decision as soon as you are reduced to negative hit points (even if it isn't your turn). If you do not choose to act as if you were disabled, you immediately fall unconscious.
When using this feat, you are staggered. You can take a move action without further injuring yourself, but if you perform any standard action (or any other action deemed as strenuous, including some swift actions, such as casting a quickened spell) you take 1 point of damage after completing the act. If your negative hit points are equal to or greater than your Constitution score, you immediately die.

effects.description:
All variable, numeric effects of an empowered spell are increased by half, including bonuses to those dice rolls.
Saving throws and opposed rolls are not affected, nor are spells without random variables. An empowered spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's actual level.

rules.name: Enlarge Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description:
You can alter a spell with a range of close, medium, or long to increase its range by 100%. An enlarged spell with a range of close now has a range of 50 ft. + 5 ft./level, while medium-range spells have a range of 200 ft. + 20 ft./level and long-range spells have a range of 800 ft. + 80 ft./level. An enlarged spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.
Spells whose ranges are not defined by distance, as well as spells whose ranges are not close, medium, or long, do not benefit from this feat.

manual: Enable only for metamagic applied to the same spell. The sheet adds slot increases, not effective spell level or save DC. Check legal spell targets, available slots and spontaneous casting time at the table. No slots are spent by these toggles.

rules.name: Extend Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description: An extended spell lasts twice as long as normal. A spell with a duration of concentration, instantaneous, or permanent is not affected by this feat. An extended spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.

manual: Enable only for metamagic applied to the same spell. The sheet adds slot increases, not effective spell level or save DC. Check legal spell targets, available slots and spontaneous casting time at the table. No slots are spent by these toggles.

rules.name: Maximize Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description:
All variable, numeric effects of a spell modified by this feat are maximized. Saving throws and opposed rolls are not affected, nor are spells without random variables. A maximized spell uses up a spell slot three levels higher than the spell's actual level.
An empowered, maximized spell gains the separate benefits of each feat: the maximum result plus half the normally rolled result.

manual: Enable only for metamagic applied to the same spell. The sheet adds slot increases, not effective spell level or save DC. Check legal spell targets, available slots and spontaneous casting time at the table. No slots are spent by these toggles.

rules.name: Quicken Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description:
Casting a quickened spell is a swift action. You can perform another action, even casting another spell, in the same round as you cast a quickened spell. A spell whose casting time is more than 1 round or 1 full-round action cannot be quickened.
A quickened spell uses up a spell slot four levels higher than the spell's actual level. Casting a quickened spell doesn't provoke an attack of opportunity.
Special: You can apply the effects of this feat to a spell cast spontaneously, so long as it has a casting time that is not more than 1 full-round action, without increasing the spell's casting time.

manual: Enable only for metamagic applied to the same spell. The sheet adds slot increases, not effective spell level or save DC. Check legal spell targets, available slots and spontaneous casting time at the table. No slots are spent by these toggles.

rules.name: Silent Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description:
A silent spell can be cast with no verbal components. Spells without verbal components are not affected. A silent spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.
Special: Bard spells cannot be enhanced by this feat.

manual: Enable only for metamagic applied to the same spell. The sheet adds slot increases, not effective spell level or save DC. Check legal spell targets, available slots and spontaneous casting time at the table. No slots are spent by these toggles.

rules.name: Still Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description: A stilled spell can be cast with no somatic components. Spells without somatic components are not affected. A stilled spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.

manual: Enable only for metamagic applied to the same spell. The sheet adds slot increases, not effective spell level or save DC. Check legal spell targets, available slots and spontaneous casting time at the table. No slots are spent by these toggles.

rules.name: Widen Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description:
You can alter a burst, emanation, or spread-shaped spell to increase its area. Any numeric measurements of the spell's area increase by 100%. A widened spell uses up a spell slot three levels higher than the spell's actual level.
Spells that do not have an area of one of these four sorts are not affected by this feat.

manual: Enable only for metamagic applied to the same spell. The sheet adds slot increases, not effective spell level or save DC. Check legal spell targets, available slots and spontaneous casting time at the table. No slots are spent by these toggles.

rules.name: Defensive Combat Training (Combat)
manual: Use total class Hit Dice instead of BAB for CMD. Racial Hit Dice are not modelled.

rules.name: Intimidating Prowess (Combat)
manual: Adds Strength modifier in addition to Charisma, including a negative Strength modifier.

rules.name: Spell Penetration
manual: Add this bonus to caster-level checks against spell resistance, not to caster level itself or spell save DC.

rules.name: Greater Spell Penetration
manual: Stacks with Spell Penetration, for +4 total against spell resistance.

rules.name: Disruptive (Combat)

effects.description: The DC to cast spells defensively increases by +4 for all enemies that are within your threatened area. This increase to casting spells defensively only applies if you are aware of the enemy's location and are capable of taking an attack of opportunity. If you can only take one attack of opportunity per round and have already used that attack, this increase does not apply.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: The +4 modifies the enemy defensive-casting DC, not your concentration bonus. Awareness, threatened area and ability to make an opportunity attack are checked at the table.

effects.description: Enemies in your threatened area that fail their checks to cast spells defensively provoke attacks of opportunity from you.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

rules.name: Strike Back (Combat)

effects.description: You can ready an action to make a melee attack against any foe that attacks you in melee, even if the foe is outside of your reach.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: This card represents readying the attack. It does not grant permanent reach or extra attacks.

rules.name: Two-Weapon Fighting (Combat)

effects.description: Your penalties on attack rolls for fighting with two weapons are reduced. The penalty for your primary hand lessens by 2 and the one for your off hand lessens by 6. See Two-Weapon Fighting in Combat.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Use one selected weapon at a time. Choose standard damage for the primary hand or off-hand damage for the secondary hand. Extra off-hand attacks use the displayed attack bonus, then −5 for the second and −10 for the third as unlocked. The normal two-weapon penalties apply to every attack; light off-hand weapons reduce both penalties to −2. No attack rolls are executed.

rules.name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting (Combat)

effects.description: In addition to the standard single extra attack you get with an off-hand weapon, you get a second attack with it, albeit at a –5 penalty.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Use one selected weapon at a time. Choose standard damage for the primary hand or off-hand damage for the secondary hand. Extra off-hand attacks use the displayed attack bonus, then −5 for the second and −10 for the third as unlocked. The normal two-weapon penalties apply to every attack; light off-hand weapons reduce both penalties to −2. No attack rolls are executed.

rules.name: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting (Combat)

effects.description: You get a third attack with your off-hand weapon, albeit at a –10 penalty.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Use one selected weapon at a time. Choose standard damage for the primary hand or off-hand damage for the secondary hand. Extra off-hand attacks use the displayed attack bonus, then −5 for the second and −10 for the third as unlocked. The normal two-weapon penalties apply to every attack; light off-hand weapons reduce both penalties to −2. No attack rolls are executed.

rules.name: Double Slice (Combat)
manual: Restores the other half of positive Strength damage on your off-hand weapon while dual-wielding. Does not change Power Attack’s off-hand bonus or secondary natural attacks. Negative Strength already applies in full.

rules.name: Two-Weapon Rend (Combat)

effects.description: If you hit an opponent with both your primary hand and your off-hand weapon, you deal an additional 1d10 points of damage plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier. You can only deal this additional damage once each round.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: The extra 1d10 + 1½ Strength is separate damage, not added to every attack line. Track the two hits against the same foe and once-per-round limit at the table.

rules.name: Scorpion Style (Combat)

effects.description: To use this feat, you must make a single unarmed attack as a standard action. If this unarmed attack hits, you deal damage normally, and the target's base land speed is reduced to 5 feet for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier unless it makes a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wis modifier).
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Use an unarmed strike, not the selected weapon unless it represents an unarmed attack. Resolve target conditions, Fortitude saves and extra attacks at the table. Scorpion duration equals Wisdom modifier; no minimum duration is invented.

rules.name: Gorgon's Fist (Combat)

effects.description: As a standard action, make a single unarmed melee attack against a foe whose speed is reduced (such as from Scorpion Style). If the attack hits, you deal damage normally and the target is staggered until the end of your next turn unless it makes a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wis modifier). This feat has no effect on targets that are staggered.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Use an unarmed strike, not the selected weapon unless it represents an unarmed attack. Resolve target conditions, Fortitude saves and extra attacks at the table. Scorpion duration equals Wisdom modifier; no minimum duration is invented.

rules.name: Medusa's Wrath (Combat)

effects.description: Whenever you use the full-attack action and make at least one unarmed strike, you can make two additional unarmed strikes at your highest base attack bonus. These bonus attacks must be made against a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Use an unarmed strike, not the selected weapon unless it represents an unarmed attack. Resolve target conditions, Fortitude saves and extra attacks at the table. Scorpion duration equals Wisdom modifier; no minimum duration is invented.

rules.name: Catch Off-Guard (Combat)

effects.description: You do not suffer any penalties for using an improvised melee weapon. Unarmed opponents are flat-footed against any attacks you make with an improvised melee weapon.

manual: The improvised checkbox applies the normal −4 penalty; this feat cancels it only for the appropriate melee/ranged mode. Target flat-footed state, weapon eligibility, damage and splash resolution remain manual.

rules.name: Throw Anything (Combat)

effects.description: You do not suffer any penalties for using an improvised ranged weapon. You receive a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls made with thrown splash weapons.

manual: The improvised checkbox applies the normal −4 penalty; this feat cancels it only for the appropriate melee/ranged mode. Target flat-footed state, weapon eligibility, damage and splash resolution remain manual.

rules.name: Improvised Weapon Mastery (Combat)

effects.description: You do not suffer any penalties for using an improvised weapon. Increase the amount of damage dealt by the improvised weapon by one step (for example, 1d4 becomes 1d6) to a maximum of 1d8 (2d6 if the improvised weapon is two-handed). The improvised weapon has a critical threat range of 19–20, with a critical multiplier of ×2.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Damage die size and the 19–20/×2 critical profile are manual equipment instructions. This feat removes the improvised penalty once, even when both prerequisite feats are owned. It does not add +4 to attacks with ordinary weapons.

rules.name: Far Shot (Combat)
manual: Select the range increment for the current ranged attack: first has no penalty; second is −1, third −2, and so on. These are total Far Shot range penalties, not bonuses to an already penalized attack. Check weapon range limits and distance at the table. Ordinary range penalties without Far Shot remain manual.

rules.name: Eschew Materials

effects.description: You can cast any spell with a material component costing 1 gp or less without needing that component. The casting of the spell still provokes attacks of opportunity as normal. If the spell requires a material component that costs more than 1 gp, you must have the material component on hand to cast the spell, as normal.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Spellcasting permission only: does not remove costly components, focus components, or normal casting actions and provocation. No inventory is consumed automatically.

rules.name: Improved Counterspell

effects.description: When counterspelling, you may use a spell of the same school that is one or more spell levels higher than the target spell.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Counterspell option only: identify the target spell and check school and spell level at the table. Does not grant free counterspells or automatically spend spell slots.

rules.name: Dazzling Display (Combat)

effects.description: While wielding the weapon in which you have Weapon Focus, you can perform a bewildering show of prowess as a full-round action. Make an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet who can see your display.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: This card applies to the selected qualified weapon. Demoralization, target conditions and damage resolution remain manual. Shatter Defenses is not a permanent attack bonus; Deadly Stroke does not double the ordinary damage column or stack its extra damage into a critical multiplier.

rules.name: Shatter Defenses (Combat)

effects.description: Any shaken, frightened, or panicked opponent hit by you this round is flat-footed to your attacks until the end of your next turn. This includes any additional attacks you make this round.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: This card applies to the selected qualified weapon. Demoralization, target conditions and damage resolution remain manual. Shatter Defenses is not a permanent attack bonus; Deadly Stroke does not double the ordinary damage column or stack its extra damage into a critical multiplier.

rules.name: Deadly Stroke (Combat)

effects.description: As a standard action, make a single attack with the weapon for which you have Greater Weapon Focus against a stunned or flat-footed opponent. If you hit, you deal double the normal damage and the target takes 1 point of Constitution bleed (see Conditions). The additional damage and bleed is not multiplied on a critical hit.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: This card applies to the selected qualified weapon. Demoralization, target conditions and damage resolution remain manual. Shatter Defenses is not a permanent attack bonus; Deadly Stroke does not double the ordinary damage column or stack its extra damage into a critical multiplier.

rules.name: Improved Critical (Combat)

effects.description:
When using the weapon you selected, your threat range is doubled.
Special: You can gain Improved Critical multiple times. The effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new type of weapon.
This effect doesn't stack with any other effect that expands the threat range of a weapon.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: For this weapon, double the width of its original threat range (20 becomes 19–20; 19–20 becomes 17–20; 18–20 becomes 15–20). Do not stack with keen or other threat-range expansion. Weapon threat ranges are not yet modelled as numerical equipment fields; use this qualified card at the table.

rules.name: Critical Mastery (Combat)

effects.description: When you score a critical hit, you can apply the effects of two critical feats in addition to the damage dealt.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Choose up to two qualifying critical effects per critical hit. Only actual Critical-category feats count for this prerequisite; the broader critical browsing theme is not a rules category.

rules.name: Two-Weapon Defense (Combat)
manual: Does not apply to natural weapons or unarmed strikes. The defensive-mode checkbox selects this feat’s shield bonus only; apply ordinary fighting-defensively/total-defense rules separately. Shield bonuses do not stack with a higher shield bonus and do not add to CMD.

rules.name: Leadership
manual: Base Leadership score is character level + Charisma modifier. Reputation, cohort-specific and follower-specific modifiers are applied separately at the table. Consult the full feat reference table; cohort level cannot exceed character level minus two. Recruitment, follower counts, alignment restrictions, replacements and cohort XP are not automated.

rules.name: Penetrating Strike (Combat)

effects.description: Your attacks with weapons selected with Weapon Focus ignore up to 5 points of damage reduction. This feat does not apply to damage reduction without a type (such as DR 10/—).
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Applies to any currently selected weapon with qualified Weapon Focus. Bypass is not bonus damage: reduce the target’s applicable damage reduction at the table. The greater amounts replace the lesser amounts.

rules.name: Greater Penetrating Strike (Combat)

effects.description: Your attacks with weapons selected with Weapon Focus ignore up to 10 points of damage reduction. This amount is reduced to 5 points for damage reduction without a type (such as DR 10/—).
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Applies to any currently selected weapon with qualified Weapon Focus. Bypass is not bonus damage: reduce the target’s applicable damage reduction at the table. The greater amounts replace the lesser amounts.

rules.name: Spell Mastery

effects.description: Each time you take this feat, choose a number of spells that you already know equal to your Intelligence modifier. From that point on, you can prepare these spells without referring to a spellbook.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Record the chosen already-known spells separately. Spell choices and repeat selections are not stored by this sheet yet; it does not grant spells known, prepared spells or spell slots.

rules.name: Spell Focus

choices.label: Spell Focus school (Greater Spell Focus uses the same school)

manual: The chosen school receives this save DC bonus; Greater Spell Focus upgrades the same school. Other schools, caster level and spell resistance checks are unchanged. Repeat purchases for additional schools are not yet modelled. Changing the selection is retraining, not a free in-play switch.

rules.name: Greater Spell Focus
manual: The chosen school receives this save DC bonus; Greater Spell Focus upgrades the same school. Other schools, caster level and spell resistance checks are unchanged. Repeat purchases for additional schools are not yet modelled. Changing the selection is retraining, not a free in-play switch.

rules.name: Skill Focus
manual: Selected skill gains +3, increasing to +6 at 10 ranks. Repeat selections and skills with specializations (such as Knowledge, Craft, Perform and Profession) remain pending. Changing the selection requires appropriate retraining.

rules.name: Extra Channel
manual: Two additional channel uses per day, tracked separately from your base pool. For a paladin these represent four extra lay on hands uses that can only power channel positive energy, not ordinary lay on hands. Base pools and recovery remain manual except this bonus counter. Core eligibility is cleric level 1 or paladin level 4; alternate feature grants or replacements are not modelled.

rules.name: Improved Channel
manual: Add +2 to channel-energy save DC only. The underlying channel dice, DC and class pool are not calculated here.

rules.name: Selective Channeling

effects.description: When you channel energy, you can choose a number of targets in the area up to your Charisma modifier. These targets are not affected by your channeled energy.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Channel energy is a class ability, not a spell. Choose excluded targets at the table; no target records or effects are stored.

rules.name: Augment Summoning

effects.description: Each creature you conjure with any summon spell gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution for the duration of the spell that summoned it.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: The +4 enhancement bonuses affect summoned creatures, not the summoner. Apply normal enhancement stacking and recalculate their statistics at the table. No summoned-creature records are created.

rules.name: Alignment Channel

effects.description:
Instead of its normal effect, you can choose to have your ability to channel energy heal or harm outsiders of the chosen alignment subtype. You must make this choice each time you channel energy. If you choose to heal or harm creatures of the chosen alignment subtype, your channel energy has no effect on other creatures. The amount of damage healed or dealt and the DC to halve the damage is otherwise unchanged.
Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take this feat, it applies to a new alignment subtype. Whenever you channel energy, you must choose which type to effect.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Choose one subtype for this purchase. At each use choose normal channeling or this alternative effect, and heal or harm as permitted. Only outsiders of the chosen subtype are affected by this alternative. Rolls, targets and base resources remain manual; additional purchases for other subtypes are not modelled.

rules.name: Elemental Channel

effects.description:
Instead of its normal effect, you can choose to have your ability to channel energy heal or harm outsiders of your chosen elemental subtype. You must make this choice each time you channel energy. If you choose to heal or harm creatures of your elemental subtype, your channel energy has no effect on other creatures. The amount of damage healed or dealt and the DC to halve the damage is otherwise unchanged.
Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take this feat, it applies to a new elemental subtype.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Choose one subtype for this purchase. At each use choose normal channeling or this alternative effect, and heal or harm as permitted. Only outsiders of the chosen subtype are affected by this alternative. Rolls, targets and base resources remain manual; additional purchases for other subtypes are not modelled.

rules.name: Channel Smite (Combat)

effects.description: Before you make a melee attack roll, you can choose to spend one use of your channel energy ability as a swift action. If you channel positive energy and you hit an undead creature, that creature takes an amount of additional damage equal to the damage dealt by your channel positive energy ability. If you channel negative energy and you hit a living creature, that creature takes an amount of additional damage equal to the damage dealt by your channel negative energy ability. Your target can make a Will save, as normal, to halve this additional damage. If your attack misses, the channel energy ability is still expended with no effect.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Declare and spend one channel use before the melee attack; a miss still spends it. Positive channel affects undead, negative affects living targets. Resolve channel dice and the target’s Will save at the table. This does not add flat damage to the weapon line or share Paladin Smite Evil uses. If spending an Extra Channel bonus use, decrement that counter manually; otherwise track the base class pool.

rules.name: Cleric channel energy type

choices.label: Cleric channel energy (choose the type permitted by your alignment/deity)

manual: Record the cleric’s actual channel type. This selector does not grant both types or permission to change it freely; alignment and deity restrictions are adjudicated at the table. Core paladin channel positive energy is recognized automatically at level 4.

rules.name: Command Undead

effects.description: As a standard action, you can use one of your uses of channel negative energy to enslave undead within 30 feet. Undead receive a Will save to negate the effect. The DC for this Will save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Charisma modifier. Undead that fail their saves fall under your control, obeying your commands to the best of their ability, as if under the effects of control undead. Intelligent undead receive a new saving throw each day to resist your command. You can control any number of undead, so long as their total Hit Dice do not exceed your cleric level. If you use channel energy in this way, it has no other effect (it does not heal or harm nearby creatures). If an undead creature is under the control of another creature, you must make an opposed Charisma check whenever your orders conflict.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Spend one use from the appropriate channel pool manually (or the Extra Channel bonus counter if used). Resolve range, saves, duration, controlled Hit Dice and opposed checks at the table. This use does not also heal or harm. The source DC formula is printed on the card; effective channel level and modifiers remain manual.

rules.name: Turn Undead

effects.description: You can, as a standard action, use one of your uses of channel positive energy to cause all undead within 30 feet of you to flee, as if panicked. Undead receive a Will save to negate the effect. The DC for this Will save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Charisma modifier. Undead that fail their save flee for 1 minute. Intelligent undead receive a new saving throw each round to end the effect. If you use channel energy in this way, it has no other effect (it does not heal or harm nearby creatures).
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Spend one use from the appropriate channel pool manually (or the Extra Channel bonus counter if used). Resolve range, saves, duration, controlled Hit Dice and opposed checks at the table. This use does not also heal or harm. The source DC formula is printed on the card; effective channel level and modifiers remain manual.

rules.name: Extra Rage
manual: This purchase adds 6 rounds per day, tracked separately from the base class pool. Each counter increment spends one round. Decrement manually when using the class ability; no effect or turn is triggered. Set the purchase count on the equipped feat; the bonus pool scales with that count. Duplicate rows alone are not extra purchases. Core class feature levels are recognized; alternate grants and archetype replacements remain manual.

rules.name: Extra Performance
manual: This purchase adds 6 rounds per day, tracked separately from the base class pool. Each counter increment spends one round. Decrement manually when using the class ability; no effect or turn is triggered. Set the purchase count on the equipped feat; the bonus pool scales with that count. Duplicate rows alone are not extra purchases. Core class feature levels are recognized; alternate grants and archetype replacements remain manual.

rules.name: Extra Ki
manual: This purchase adds 2 points per day, tracked separately from the base class pool. Each counter increment spends one point. Decrement manually when using the class ability; no effect or turn is triggered. Set the purchase count on the equipped feat; the bonus pool scales with that count. Duplicate rows alone are not extra purchases. Core class feature levels are recognized; alternate grants and archetype replacements remain manual.

rules.name: Extra Lay On Hands
manual: This purchase adds 2 uses per day, tracked separately from the base class pool. Each counter increment spends one use. Decrement manually when using the class ability; no effect or turn is triggered. Set the purchase count on the equipped feat; the bonus pool scales with that count. Duplicate rows alone are not extra purchases. Core class feature levels are recognized; alternate grants and archetype replacements remain manual.
These are ordinary lay on hands uses, unlike the restricted Extra Channel bonus. If used for paladin channeling, spend two lay on hands uses manually; do not also spend an Extra Channel bonus use.

rules.name: Heighten Spell (Metamagic)

effects.description: A heightened spell has a higher spell level than normal (up to a maximum of 9th level). Unlike other metamagic feats, Heighten Spell actually increases the effective level of the spell that it modifies. All effects dependent on spell level (such as saving throw DCs and ability to penetrate a lesser globe of invulnerability) are calculated according to the heightened level. The heightened spell is as difficult to prepare and cast as a spell of its effective level.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Choose the effective spell level at the table, above the original level and no higher than 9. Increase the spell save DC by that level difference, then apply school bonuses such as Spell Focus normally. Other metamagic slot increases add to the heightened level but do not further increase effective spell level or DC. The metamagic adjustment total on this sheet excludes Heighten: add it to the chosen heightened level when determining the required slot. Spell selection, level choice, slot availability and casting time remain manual.

rules.name: Extra Mercy

effects.description:
Select one additional mercy for which you qualify. When you use lay on hands to heal damage to one target, it also receives the additional effects of this mercy.
Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take this feat, select a new mercy.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Choose and record one additional mercy for which you qualify, checking paladin level and prerequisite mercies at the table. It applies when lay on hands heals one target; it does not grant extra uses, modify channeling, or improve Smite Evil. Mercy selections and repeated purchases are not stored yet.

rules.name: Natural Spell

effects.description:
You can complete the verbal and somatic components of spells while using wild shape. You substitute various noises and gestures for the normal verbal and somatic components of a spell.
You can also use any material components or focuses you possess, even if such items are melded within your current form. This feat does not permit the use of magic items while you are in a form that could not ordinarily use them, and you do not gain the ability to speak while using wild shape.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: The checkbox records wild shape; it does not grant the ability, spend a use or transform your statistics. This permission applies to wild shape, not every polymorph effect. It grants neither speech nor permission to use otherwise unusable magic items. Spell selection, slots, components and casting actions remain manual. Core druid wild shape is recognized at level 4; alternate grants and archetype replacements remain manual.

rules.name: Armor Proficiency, Light (Combat)

effects.description: When you wear a type of armor with which you are proficient, the armor check penalty for that armor applies only to Dexterity- and Strength-based skill checks.
restrictions: Resolve rolls, timing and target eligibility at the table. This card does not create extra attack rolls or apply effects to enemies.

manual: Proficiency restricts the equipment armor check penalty to Strength- and Dexterity-based skills; it does not remove that penalty. Equipment AC, armor check penalties, speed, arcane spell failure and special restrictions remain manual. This card does not add AC or cancel attack penalties automatically. Core class bonus feats are granted at level 1; supplemental classes and archetype replacements require separate verification.

rules.name: Armor Proficiency, Medium (Combat)

To brew a potion, you must use up raw materials costing one half this base price. See the magic item creation rules in Magic Items for more information.

rules.name: Stunning Fist (Combat)

effects.description:
You must declare that you are using this feat before you make your attack roll (thus, a failed attack roll ruins the attempt). Stunning Fist forces a foe damaged by your unarmed attack to make a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wis modifier), in addition to dealing damage normally. A defender who fails this saving throw is stunned for 1 round (until just before your next turn). A stunned character drops everything held, can't take actions, loses any Dexterity bonus to AC, and takes a –2 penalty to AC. You may attempt a stunning attack once per day for every four levels you have attained (but see Special), and no more than once per round. Constructs, oozes, plants, undead, incorporeal creatures, and creatures immune to critical hits cannot be stunned.
Special: A monk receives Stunning Fist as a bonus feat at 1st level, even if he does not meet the prerequisites. A monk may attempt a stunning attack a number of times per day equal to his monk level, plus one more time per day for every four levels he has in classes other than monk.
